steps.what: Select the appropriate established examination sequence and use chemicals or other substances to develop latent fingerprint evidence, preserving the item and actual examination observations.
Use the existing authorised fingerprint comparison database {OTHER} to retrieve candidate known prints with the established search tools; check case permissions and print quality.
Examine and compare the developed prints with the candidate known prints; assess ridge detail, limitations and alternative explanations under the established forensic method.
Write and check the actual development and comparison findings, image references and limitations in the existing forensic case system {OTHER}.
Save the checked final examination record in the forensic case system {OTHER} for the existing verification process.

tasks.design: Retain the established fingerprint search tools in {OTHER} and the existing forensic case record. After separating chemical development, database retrieval, comparison and record writing, this scenario offers no demonstrated labour-reducing change.
tasks.previous_blocker: The difficult work is reliable evidence examination, not an absent report template.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native candidate retrieval is already part of the baseline, so it earns no new saving.
tasks.still_hard: Partial, distorted or contaminated ridge detail needs competent examination and the existing verification process.
tasks.human_edge: State what the evidence supports and where a comparison remains inconclusive.

ambition.what: No new identification or case-release authority.

tasks.altitude: The examination workflow and decision rights stay the same.

reach.learn: Forensic comparison limitations and source-image provenance.

evidence.claim: Fingerprint candidate retrieval does not remove the need for examination of the developed print and recorded comparison reasoning.

assumptions: Boundary is the technician's development and comparison through its stored examination record. Independent verification, evidence transfer and court reporting remain separate unchanged work. Shares are illustrative, not measured.

The technician produces evidence ID, method and reagent reference, actual development observations, image ID, search reference, comparison observations and limitations in s1-s4. Known prints come from the existing authorised database. Missing or poor-quality evidence is resolved manually, not reconstructed by a model.

Native search and case-record configuration were considered and are assumed already used. The actual record writing and save remain explicit and unchanged; no new checklist, report or approval ceremony is invented.

The ordinary author check in s4 binds the exact s5 record snapshot. Saving the record does not bypass independent verification or authorise a criminal identification decision. No new tool means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Actual native search and record configuration
research_questions: Is any repeated source-reference transcription demonstrably outside the existing native tools?

already_counted.description: Write and check the examination record and its limitations.

incremental.description: No changed tool or workflow; no incremental maintenance is introduced.

approvals.approved_version: Final examination record snapshot checked at the end of s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Development, existing database retrieval, detailed comparison, record writing and save all retain their full shares. No additional labour-saving mechanism is evidenced in this scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Measure and sketch the crime scene

steps.what: Examine the crime scene and take actual distances, dimensions and reference-point measurements while preserving evidence positions and scene access controls.
Record the actual measurements, evidence identifiers, orientation and uncertainties in field notes; make the rough scene sketch that ties each measurement to its reference points.

Prepare the final scene sketch in technical drawing software {OTHER}; configure native coordinate entry, scale and evidence-label styles, then verify every point, dimension and uncertainty against the rough sketch and field notes.
Save the checked final scene sketch and its field-note references in the forensic case system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Use the native coordinate, scale and label features of technical drawing software {OTHER} to prepare the final sketch from the technician's actual field notes. Preserve the original notes and rough sketch; a person checks the final geometry and meaning before storage.
tasks.previous_blocker: Final sketches repeatedly redrew measured geometry and evidence labels.
tasks.enabler_now: Native drawing features can reproduce explicit coordinates and label styles without inferring unseen scene details.
tasks.still_hard: Occlusion, disturbed evidence and uncertain reference points require direct examination and clear limitations.
tasks.human_edge: Decide which measurements faithfully document the scene and what uncertainty must be shown.

ambition.what: No expansion of evidence interpretation authority.

tasks.altitude: Less final-sketch redrawing; the same scene examination and verification remain.

evidence.claim: Technical drawing software can construct explicit coordinates and consistent scale and label styles.

assumptions: Boundary is scene measurement and its sketch through case storage; evidence interpretation and external distribution are separate. Shares are an adoption scenario.

The technician captures scene ID, point and evidence IDs, reference origin, orientation, coordinate or distance values, units, method and uncertainty in s1-s2. If coordinates cannot be reconstructed reliably, manual drawing and source checking remain the fallback. No free scanning or image interpretation is assumed.
Try native drawing configuration first. Only repeated final drawing operations lose time; actual measurement, source notes and the full geometric check stay counted in s1-s3.
s3's ordinary final sketch check binds the exact saved version. Any corrected point or label requires rechecking before s4.
unknowns: Available reference geometry and drawing import support
research_questions: Can native drawing styles preserve uncertain dimensions without implying false precision?

already_counted.description: Enter and check the final sketch against field geometry and evidence references.

incremental.description: Maintain drawing styles and test coordinate and unit handling.

approvals.approved_version: Final scene sketch and field-note references checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native geometry and labels remove 35% of the 24-hour final-sketch share: 8.4 gross hours less 1.5 upkeep. Zero if already configured. Physical scene work and source notes retain all 75 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Visit morgues, examine crime scenes or contact the relevant sources; obtain evidence or information through the established investigative and evidence-handling procedures.
Capture and check actual source information, evidence identifiers, origin, collection circumstances and limitations in the existing forensic case record {OTHER}.
Save the checked final collection record in the forensic case system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Keep evidence collection and source contact with the technician, followed by the existing native case form in {OTHER}. The source capture, author check and save have been separated; none has a supported additional automation gain in this scenario.
tasks.previous_blocker: The limiting factor is access to actual evidence and reliable sources.
tasks.enabler_now: The existing case form already provides structured collection fields; its runtime is not a new labour saving.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain provenance and conflicting information require direct inquiry and professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish what a source actually supplied from an investigator's inference.
tasks.altitude: Work and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify the limits of biological evidence

evidence.claim: A case record can structure evidence provenance, but obtaining and evaluating the underlying source information remains human work.

assumptions: Boundary is obtaining evidence or information through its collection record. This does not repeat the distinct fingerprint comparison or scene measurement work in other tasks. Shares describe a typical case, not measured labour.

The technician produces case ID, evidence ID, source, actual collection time and location, observed condition, information supplied and limitations during s1-s2. Direct manual entry is already the baseline. No planned visit is recorded as completed; missing provenance requires actual inquiry.
Native form configuration is assumed already adequate after considering the record-writing step separately. No extra summary, notification or new approval duty is introduced.

The normal author check at the end of s2 covers the final record saved in s3; changes void it. Physical evidence transfer and any separate disclosure follow their existing processes. No changed tool means zero incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Actual use of the existing structured collection form
Access delays and missing provenance patterns
research_questions: Is any repeated transcription present beyond the first capture of source information?

already_counted.description: Capture and check the actual collection record.

incremental.description: No new tool or workflow maintenance.

approvals.approved_version: Final collection record checked at the end of s2

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All source contact, physical collection, record writing and save time is retained. No duplicate administrative baseline is invented to create a saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Prepare the technique demonstration and exercise material from approved methods in {DOCS}; use native section styles and approved exercise templates while personally selecting the material and checking the completed instructions.
Demonstrate the forensic technique, supervise practice, explain limitations and observe whether the learner can perform the procedure correctly.
Write and check the actual attendance, exercise performed, observed limitations and follow-up in the existing {LMS} training record.
Save the checked final training record in {LMS} without automatically granting competence or examination authority.

tasks.design: Reuse approved exercise layouts and method sections through native {DOCS} templates. The technician checks the material, teaches and observes practice, then records actual training in {LMS}; no model assesses a learner's competence.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training exercise headings and approved procedural sections were repeatedly laid out.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates can preserve approved section references and exercise layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing when a trainee understands contamination control and evidential limits requires observed practice.
tasks.human_edge: Spot an apparently fluent trainee who is making a consequential procedural error.
tasks.altitude: Small preparation savings leave the teaching and assessment role intact.

reach.learn: Observable competence criteria and forensic method limitations.

evidence.claim: Document templates can reuse approved training sections without evaluating learner competence.

assumptions: Boundary is preparing and delivering training through the existing record, not a separate formal authorisation to examine evidence. Shares are illustrative. Learner practice time is unchanged and not credited to the trainer.

The trainer selects method ID and revision, exercise ID and learning objectives in s1; after actual delivery supplies date, attendee, procedure performed, observed result and follow-up in s3. Manual selection and entry remain counted. No attendance or success is inferred from a planned session.
Try native document templates first. Savings are layout and repeated approved references only; all scientific selection, final material checks, coaching and record capture remain.

The ordinary author check in s3 approves the exact final record saved in s4. Edits require recheck. Training examples are already cleared for teaching; no additional case-data access or unpaid anonymisation is assumed.
unknowns: Current use of reusable training exercises
research_questions: Can method revisions remain visible when a native exercise template is reused?

already_counted.description: Select and check the completed exercise material.

incremental.description: Update exercise templates when approved methods change.

approvals.approved_version: Final actual training record checked at the end of s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native layout reuse removes 20% of the 20-hour preparation share: 4 gross hours less 1 upkeep. Zero with templates already in use. Teaching, actual record capture and save retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Forensic technicians retain evidence examination and teaching decisions; a bounded drawing and template improvement reduces repeated preparation only.
reach: Review method and training evidence with quality control analysts
role.ambitious_version: Produce traceable forensic records while preserving direct examination and explicit evidential limitations.
